thread:
harper: Heads up — noticed a spike in onboarding failures. Quickstart Node sample errors with `Error: Cannot find module '@redwood/inference/dist/index.cjs'`. :grimacing:

mino: Yikes. Which release? can you paste `npm pack` output from the published tarball?

harper: It's 1.4.0. `npm pack` shows:
```
package/README.md
package/dist/edge/index.mjs
package/dist/edge/index.mjs.map
package/package.json
```
No `dist/node` and no `dist/types`.

publish-bot: publish job: https://ci.example.com/jobs/5102 — packaging step used `files: ["dist/**","README.md"]` but our `.npmignore` accidentally excludes `dist/node` (leftover). DTS step writes to `dist/_types` because of a legacy script, so types omitted.

lex: That would break Node `require()` consumers and TypeScript intellisense. Also saw Sentry frames referencing `index.cjs.map` even though only `.mjs` shipped. Sourcemap mismatch.

harper: We also have an unrelated regression: the node bundle retries on 401 in the browser bundle but not in node. Auth wrapper looks different between edge/node builds. Might be caused by different build-time flags.

mino: OK actionable plan: 1) Rebuild with tsup formats `['cjs','esm']` for node and edge, enable dts output to `dist/types`. 2) Fix `.npmignore` and `package.json` `files` to include `dist/node` and `dist/types`. 3) Add a CI pre-publish "pack-check" that runs `npm pack && tar -tf` and then smoke tests: node require, ESM import, `tsc --noEmit`. 4) Add a test that asserts identical retry/auth behavior across bundles (unit + integration).

ops: Agree. Also we should make `exports` explicit: `"./": {"import":"./dist/edge/index.mjs","require":"./dist/node/index.cjs"}` and avoid using a single ambiguous `main` entry.

harper: For a short-term mitigation I can republish 1.4.1-rc with node artifacts and types placed under `dist/types`. Will run local pack-check before publishing stable.

publish-bot: Local `npm pack` for 1.4.1-rc (tar list):
```
package/dist/node/index.cjs
package/dist/node/index.cjs.map
package/dist/edge/index.mjs
package/dist/edge/index.mjs.map
package/dist/types/index.d.ts
package/package.json
```
Smoke tests: node require/import ✅, ESM import on Vercel preview ✅, tsc typecheck ✅.

mino: Nice. Follow-ups: 1) RFC to standardize publish layout (dist/{node,edge,types}) and `exports` mapping; 2) add CI pack-check and a lightweight publish-lint that compares `package.json` files[] against actual dist dirs; 3) ensure tsup build flags are unified between bundles to avoid runtime predicate differences (auth/retry).

lex: I'll file the RFC and the CI PR. Also adding a release checklist item: "verify artifact matrix (.cjs, .mjs, .d.ts), source maps, and exports consistency".

harper: Filed RFC: https://go.redwood.com/rfc/sdk-publish-standard — contains tsup config proposal and CI pack-check spec.

ops: After stable publish, notify support and update onboarding quickstart to recommend `import` for Node >=14 but include a `require()` fallback snippet that does `let sdk = require('@redwood/inference'); if (!sdk.default) sdk = (await import('@redwood/inference')).default;` for older environments.

mino: Small note re: source maps — ensure the bundler emits maps that reference `.mjs`/`.cjs` appropriately (set `sourcemap: true` and don't rewrite paths). Also enable `declarationMap` for dts so IDEs can map types back to sources.

harper: Publishing 1.4.1 stable now. Will paste final tarball list and close thread once CI merges the pack-check PR. Thanks all. :tada:

publish-bot: 1.4.1 published. Tarball verification and smoke tests passed in CI. Support notified.

mino: Closing once the CI pack-check and publish-lint PRs land.
